distinguishing_features: Uses a bonded compliant elastomer liner rather than hardening or replacing the erosion-prone surface.
Reduces peak contact stress by increasing particle-impact contact duration and distributing the impulse.
Specifies a deployable 10-15 mm polyurethane or Thiokol lining for the pipeline bottom and lower quadrants.
parsed.objective_technical_problem: Protect a hydro-transport pipeline bottom from sliding-bed abrasion and particle impact without relying on a hard, potentially fatigue- or spalling-prone surface treatment.
parsed.viable_reason: A bonded elastomer liner is a physically deployable and testable slurry-erosion barrier, although its wear life and actual contact-time behavior would require empirical validation.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: A skilled slurry-erosion engineer would readily regard a replaceable rubber or polyurethane lining as an obvious alternative to hard-facing when seeking to reduce particle-impact stress.
